summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Agnico Eagle Mines Limited to report its first quarter 2026 results via a press release dated April 30, 2026. The filing contains routine quarterly financial and operating metrics, including record operating margins and adjusted net income. It mentions proposed acquisitions in Finland and an expanded share repurchase program in forward-looking commentary, but no definitive deal terms, board actions, or special-situation mechanics are specified. The filing does not disclose a transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return event, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change. As a routine earnings release, it does not qualify as a special situation.
